name: Relevance
description: Measures how well the response relates to the context of the conversation. A relevant response directly addresses or connects to the preceding dialogue and provided facts.

name: Coherence
description: Assesses the logical flow and clarity of the response. A coherent response should make sense and follow logically from the context without introducing confusing or unrelated elements.

name: Engagement
description: Evaluates the ability of the response to maintain or enhance the interest of the conversation. An engaging response invites further interaction or adds an interesting perspective.

name: Creativity
description: Judges the originality and inventiveness of the response. A creative response offers a unique or unexpected continuation that enriches the dialogue.

name: Fact Utilization
description: Measures how effectively the response incorporates the interesting fact provided. A good use of the fact enhances the conversation and ties back to the context.

name: Tone Appropriateness
description: Checks if the tone of the response matches the tone of the conversation. An appropriate tone maintains consistency with the context and the other participant's style.
